title: Module test A2.3 · Complex phrases and irregular verbs

blocks.text: Module test A2.3 · Complex phrases and irregular verbs
Instructions

Week 82 of the calendar, after the verifications01, ONO-02 and A2-13 → A2-18. Duration: approx. 90 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10–12 minutes of conversation with the tutor. Work without notes and dictionary; Correct at the end with the solution. Part B script is at the beginning of solutions: let another person read it or paste it into a voice synthesis app without reading it. The text of Part A is partially spoken.

rows: Listening: a message in the voice mail
Language: relative, subordinate, irregular verbs, derived forms

blocks.text: Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings. If you do not pass the test, dedicate the week after the weakest unit (look where you lost more points in part C) and repeat the test with the tutor.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧برنامج الدورة⁩ : ⁧الموضوع⁩ · ⁧لوكا⁩ : ⁧إلى⁩ · ⁧طارق⁩ : ⁧من⁩
⁧أهلًا يا لوكا،⁩
⁧أُرسل لك برنامج الدورة التي ستبدأ يوم الاثنين ١٣ يوليو. في الصباح ستدرسون الفصحى مع الأستاذة⁩
⁧، لأنّ⁩ « ⁧أمّ يوسف⁩ » ⁧منى عبد الرحمن، وهي المدرّسة التي دَرَّسَتْ أختي قبل عشر سنوات. الطلاب يُسَمُّونَهَا⁩
. ⁧ابنها الكبير اسمه يوسف⁩
⁧بعد الظهر سَيُنَظَّمُ كلّ يوم نشاط مختلف: زيارة لمتحف، أو نقاش مع طلاب مصريين، أو درس في اللهجة⁩
⁧المصرية لمن يريد. الحضور في الصباح إجباري، أمّا النشاطات فاختيارية.⁩
⁧إذا وصلتَ يوم الأحد، فاسْتَرِحْ في الشقّة، لأنّ اليوم الأول طويل: سَيُطْلَبُ منكم أن تكتبوا امتحانًا قصيرًا⁩
⁧قبل أن يُقَسَّمَ الطلاب إلى مجموعتين. لا تَخَفْ: الامتحان لتحديد المستوى فقط.⁩
⁧يبدو أنّ الطقس سيكون حارًّا جدًّا، لذلك أنصحك بأن تشتري قبّعة، وألّا تمشي في الشمس بعد الظهر. وإذا⁩
⁧نَسِيتَ شيئًا، فكلّ ما تحتاج إليه تجده في السوق الذي أمام العمارة.⁩
⁧أظنّ أنّه سيستقبلك⁩ .« ⁧الضابط الإيطالي الذي يتكلّم الفصحى⁩ » ⁧عمّ أحمد سأل عنك! قال إنّه ينتظر⁩ : ⁧أخيرًا⁩
⁧كأنّك وزير! طارقإلى اللقاء،⁩

Help: ⁧نَشَاط⁩ "Activity" ⁧أَمَّا⁩ … ⁧فَـ⁩ As to... ⁧اِسْتَرِحْ⁩ Rested (X, concave) · ⁧يُقَسَّمُ⁩ • they are divided · ⁧مَجْمُوعَة⁩ Group of the European Communities ⁧المُسْتَوَى⁩ The level is the same as the level is the same. ⁧أَلَّا⁩ = ⁧أَنْ⁩ + ⁧لَا⁩ · ⁧الضَّابِط⁩ The officer shall be appointed. ⁧كَأَنَّكَ⁩ It's like you're gonna be. Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. Who will teach standard Arabic in the morning? Why do students call it "Umm" Yūsuf• and what connection has
with the family of Ṭāriq?
2. What happens in the afternoon? What is mandatory and what is optional?
3. Why does Luke have to rest on Sundays? What is the first day's exam for?
4. What Counsel He Gives Ṭāriq For the heat? Where is everything that's missing?
5. What he said ʿAmm Aḥmad of Luke, and what he thinks Ṭāriq?
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the message twice, with 30 Second pause. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. What has changed and why?
2. What should Luke do if he cannot come?
3. What you found NādyaWhere?
4. Where is the object now, and what must Luke do?
C · Language (12 points)

One point for an answer. Write with your vowels. Relative. 1. Complete: ⁧الشُّرْطِيَّانِ ◌ رَأَيْتُهُمَا عِنْدَ البَابِ⁩ · 2. Join: ⁧هٰذَا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ. سَيَّارَةُ الرَّجُلِ سُرِقَتْ⁩ . Subordinate. 3. Complete with ⁧أَنْ⁩ or ⁧أَنَّ⁩ : ⁧أَعْرِفُ ◌ الدَّرْسَ صَعْبٌ⁩ . · 4. Translate: "If you're lost, call me. 5. Translate: Before you go out, close the window. Write the form: 6. ⁧قَالَ⁩ ( ⁧أَنَا⁩ , perfect) · 7. ⁧نَسِيَ⁩ ( ⁧هُمْ⁩ , perfect) · 8. ⁧مَشَى⁩ ( ⁧هُوَ⁩ , juxtaposed with ⁧لَمْ⁩ ) · 9. ⁧رَدَّ⁩ ( ⁧أَنَا⁩ , perfect) · 10. Write the hamza in the right seat: ⁧مَسْ◌ُول⁩ Shapes derived. 11. Root and form of ⁧يَسْتَقْبِلُ⁩ · 12. Turn to the passive: ⁧كَتَبُوا التَّقْرِيرَ⁩ .
D · Written production (8 points)

Write about 120 words, vocalized, to an Arabic colleague who will replace you at work (or in an association) while you are on holiday. Explain to him what he has to do, the rules, what to do if something happens. Mandatory elements: three related (one without ⁧الَّذِي⁩ after an indefinite name, two conditions with ⁧إِذَا⁩ , a phrase with ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ or ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ , a case with ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ , three weak verbs, three derived-form verbs (II-X), one passive or ⁧تَمَّ⁩ + maṣdar. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4 (heading 6.3). Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production: guided conversation (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10–12 minutes.
1. Who's who? The tutor shows you a group photo: describe four people with relative (the man who..., the two
women who...).
2. If that happens... The tutor describes three situations (a tourist got lost, the power went off at the office, a
from the instructions with ⁧إِذَا⁩ and ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ / ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ .
3. An episode. Tells a little incident of the past (something lost or forgotten) with at least six

weak verbs; Then he explains to the tutor, in Arabic, how a complete Arabic name is composed that the tutor writes to you on the board. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. The Pronunciation evaluates the tutor; Without tutoring the E part remains unfinished.
